findings.title: Movable equipment must be kept at least 0.6 m clear of any machine guarding fence.
findings.summary: 原报告保存 6 项违反记录、14 项证据限制。

findings.title: No person may stand within 1.2 m of an industrial robot arm while it is enclosed by guarding.
findings.summary: policy not evaluable: The conditional clause 'while it is enclosed by guarding' requires evaluating enclosure status and spatial containment of the robot by a safety fence, which is not supported by the simple predicate vocabulary.

findings.title: Marked walkways must remain clear: no pallet may come within 0.5 m of a floor marking line.
findings.summary: no entity matching subject labels ['pallet'] passed the evidence gates

findings.title: A fire extinguisher must be within 15 m of every control panel on the shop floor.
findings.summary: no entity matching subject labels ['fire extinguisher'] passed the evidence gates

findings.title: Stacked pallets must not exceed 2.5 m in height.
findings.summary: no entity matching subject labels ['pallet'] passed the evidence gates

findings.title: Portable ladders showing more than 10 degrees of lean must be taken out of service.
findings.summary: no entity matching subject labels ['step ladder'] passed the evidence gates

findings.title: Storage racks must not encroach into a marked walkway at all.
findings.summary: no entity matching subject labels ['storage rack'] passed the evidence gates

findings.title: Every worker on the production floor must wear a hard hat at all times.
findings.summary: no entity matching subject labels ['worker'] passed the evidence gates

findings.title: Emergency stop buttons must be repainted red every two years.
findings.summary: policy not evaluable: The system cannot verify paint color (red) or track temporal maintenance schedules (every two years).

legacy.description: 原报告模型估计尺度；不是新重建的物理标定。

mapping_notes: 新照片、3D、CAD 投影和交互平面按相同 scene object id 联动。新俯视轮廓是全部实际网格顶点的凸包，孔洞和悬挑会被凸包覆盖，不代表地面接触面。
只有 left_post→inv15/21、right_post→inv16/22、right_fence→inv13/19 经同次拍摄的 canonical mask 逐像素一致验证。其它旧库存没有对应生成对象。
新 frame_0001 对应旧 frame_0003，新 frame_0003 对应旧 frame_0004；两个 run 的 frame id 命名空间不同。旧 frame_0001/2 不是这次相同机器人状态的照片。
历史 assessment 和九条策略结果直接来自 user-bor1-02；未在新三图几何上重新运行。旧库存无逐条 policy status，不能从整体 FAIL 推给每个对象。
旧 CAD 原始 map 的 inv8 有两个点超出图片左边界；坐标原样保留，显示时按图片边界裁切。
新几何与旧 CAD 使用独立坐标和尺度；旧 moge_anchor 置信度不是实测准确率。新几何不标米，native_to_floor 只有刚体变换。
mask polygon 为零基像素中心轮廓，最大简化偏移 0.5 像素；含内外环并按 evenodd 填充。bbox 使用右/下边界不包含的像素区间。
指标为全部输入视图拟合结果；before_depth/after_depth 是各视图重叠区域相对深度中位误差的等权均值，不是毫米精度或留出测试。
observed_floor 网格来自 frame_0003，只有该帧参与此对象照片联动；地面拟合本身还使用了 frame_0001 的观测点。
补充条目仅是同次拍摄的独立实例观测；保留原候选 ID，不跨帧/按标签合并实物。旧库存索引未迁移。
仅迁移 manifest 验证的同拍摄帧：frame_0003→frame_0001、frame_0004→frame_0003；无匹配的目标帧没有完整实例清单，未映射来源详见覆盖审计。
补充几何只来自本次 Pi3X 点图，不移用旧 MapAnything 的位姿、尺度或模型。来源原图 mask 经两次记录的最近邻缩放；canonical mask 不伪装为原图精度。
补充平面轮廓为有效观测点的凸包，H/W/D 为可见范围，未标定为米；原生成模型指标完全未变。
